title: Mixed Event — Nocturne Interlude — Episode5 What We Believe In

meta.Event Outline: Toya has decided to create street music as a member of Vivid BAD SQUAD. But something happens to make him wonder if classical music still has some hold on him, leading to some self-doubt...

rows.Line: Weekend Garage

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Sigh... I've got nothing...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Me neither...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: This is the best us dimwits can do, huh?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Still, thank you all...
For taking this so seriously...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Of course!
That's what teammates are for!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: But let's take a short breather and think about this again later. Hmm...?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
More and more customers are coming in.
We won't be able to dawdle much longer...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Why don't we all go over there for a change?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Over there...? Oh, right! Over there!
Crase Cafe

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Maybe as a container for these sugar sticks...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Miku, what're you doing there?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Remember that cracked cup we found the other day?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I'm trying to think of another way to use it because it would be such a waste to just throw it away.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Hehe. You really like that cup, don't you?
Oh...?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hi there, MEIKO!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: We're here!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yo.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hey! Welcome back, everyone!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Rin and Len are out running errands.
Feel free to sit wherever you like.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Are you here to practice today?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: No, we just finished and wanted to have a little break. I'm so tired after that heavy discussion we just had!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I see. Was it about coming up with a good set list for the event or something?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Oh, no... We were actually talking about me today...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: About you...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Your dad, huh...?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
That does sound like a thorny issue.
There's not much we can do about it either...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: We know... But we still want to find a way to help, you know?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: That's very like you to feel that way.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
But well...
I didn't know Toya's father was like that.
...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Is something wrong, Miku?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh, I was just thinking about something.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Classical music and street music are still both music, right?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: In that case, why does he feel classical music is fine but street music is not?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
He's just being plain stubborn, right?
He believes some music is better than other types of music...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: But Toya's father also loves music as a whole, right? That means we should all be on the same page.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: He loves music...?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, you know what...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: We're trying so hard to think of a way to reach out to Aoyagi's father because we love street music...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: But maybe this is really more of a two-way street?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: How do you mean?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Basically, he's making you play classical music because he loves it and wants you to appreciate it more as well.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Because he loves classical music...

rows.Speaker: Toya's Father
rows.Line: Remember, you were born to play classical music! Why can't you understand what I'm trying to do for you?

rows.Speaker: Toya's Father
rows.Line: Get your head out of the clouds!

rows.Speaker: Toya's Father
rows.Line: You know very well how much value and meaning classical music brings to peoples' lives. I thought I taught you that myself!

rows.Speaker: Toya's Father
rows.Line: And yet you choose to get wrapped up in this...noise! Don't you realize your life is going to become empty because of it?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: My life is going to become empty...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I get it now. That's what he believes in...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Huh?
Believes in what?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: He believes that classical music is the best way to leave one's mark on life.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: That pursuing and exploring this path is the best way to find happiness... He firmly believes in that.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
He wants me to be happy.
That's why he keeps telling me to go back.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
So what? That's just his opinion.
He has no right to force it on you like that.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: You're the only one who knows what's gonna make you happy.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: That's true, but...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Maybe, from his point of view, I'm deliberately abandoning a path that leads to happiness.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: However...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Just as he believes classical music brings happiness, I believe that our music does the same as well.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: This music was how I met Akito and found my dream.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Which led to us teaming up with Shiraishi and Azusawa.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: It made me believe from the bottom of my heart that singing is fun, and I want to share that feeling.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I firmly believe this music is something I can't live without anymore.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Then tell him that.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I agree.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
You were so cool just now, Toya.
We could all tell how you feel.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Absolutely! I feel like what you just said should get through to even your father!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: You can do it Aoyagi!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Y-You're right...
Nothing will change unless I do something.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I guess moving forward in life takes courage. The courage to keep trying again and again...
